verification.note: Confirmed by reading the code. focus-mode-touch-desktop.spec.ts:121 and :133 compare window.scrollY before and after the swipe. On the focus-drive fixture (fixtures/focusMode.tsx:153-166) the page is AppShell's min-h-dvh column, which has only paddingTop: safe-area in the focus layout (AppShell.tsx:381-384). Inside it, the hidden header is position:fixed and out of the flow (globals.css:693-698), and main holds one h-below-header box whose height is calc(100dvh - safe-area) in the focus layout (globals.css:685-687). TwoPaneLayout.tsx:153 adds overflow-clip, and only its right pane scrolls (overflow-y-auto, :193). The document's height therefore equals the viewport, so window.scrollY stays 0 whatever the gesture does. The handle is position:fixed, so its scroll chain goes to the viewport, which cannot scroll here. That makes the scroll assertion vacuous. If touch-none (AppShell.tsx:105) were removed, the scroll assertion would still pass; only the reveal assertion might catch a pointercancel. decisions.md:18 also records that in the live app the document height equals the viewport on the files used.

Confirmed. In docs/specs/focus-mode.md, §4 step 4 (lines 165-167) says 'a visible 56×22px pill with a down chevron inside an 88×44px hit area', D7 (line 378) says 'a handle pill with a down chevron', and D11 (line 386) says 'a 56×22px pill inside an 88×44px hit area'. None of them mentions a pull or swipe reveal. invariants.md has no revision of these lines (a grep for pill, chevron, bar, swipe and pull finds nothing). The code draws a 36×5 rounded bar with no svg (AppShell.tsx:107) and reveals on a downward pull of 12px or more (AppShell.tsx:66-67, 88-97). The human's decision appears only in decisions.md:37-41. DESIGN.md:836 reflects the change in part, but the spec does not.

specification_compliance: SPEC-CORE-129 §4 step 4, D7 and D11 in docs/specs/focus-mode.md still describe a 56×22 pill with a chevron and no swipe reveal. The code draws a 36×5 bar and reveals on a downward pull (the spec and code disagree, as F2 says).
The 88×44 hit area at the safe area's top centre matches D11 (AppShell.tsx:104-105).
potential_unspecified_behavior: The downward pull reveal (AppShell.tsx:88-97, threshold 12px) is not in the spec text. Only decisions.md records it.
